title: ophiorrhiza rugosa var. angustifolia
intro: Ophiorrhiza rugosa var. angustifolia, commonly known as Narrow-leaved Shoreline Milkwort, is a plant species used in traditional medicine. It is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and fever, as well as its potential to treat various infections and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Ophiorrhiza rugosa var. angustifolia include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
